profilePicture.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Create a premium square 1024x1024 publisher profile portrait for indie Unity asset maker maratg2, using the attached real portrait as the identity reference. Preserve the recognizable young man's face, medium length side-parted brown hair, green eyes, clean-shaven face, slight friendly smile and white crewneck. Render him as a carefully crafted stylized low-poly 3D character bust: sculpted angular planes, tasteful faceted hair, subtle tactile matte materials, natural skin color, elegant indie-game art rather than cartoon caricature. Bust looking gently towards the viewer, centered with generous safe space for circular avatar cropping, shoulders and top of hair within safe area. Background: solid very dark forest charcoal #0a0c0b with a quiet mint #7cf2a8 rim light outlining the silhouette; warm soft studio key light. Strong readable silhouette at 64px. No typography, no logos, no props, no frame, no watermark, no photoreal skin. Make it distinctive, polished and personable.

promoBanner.initialPrompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium ultra-wide publisher promo banner for the indie game asset maker maratg2. Wide 3:1 aspect ratio, target 2400x800. Use the attached avatar as the identity and visual-style reference, keep this exact recognizable clean-shaven young man with brown medium-length side-parted hair, white crewneck, faceted low-poly sculptural bust, natural skin, mint edge light. Place his bust in the right third, fully composed within the banner height. Left two-thirds: impeccable, highly readable editorial typography: exact lowercase brand "maratg2" large in off-white clean geometric sans; beneath it the exact smaller line "Low-poly props. Everyday stories." in soft mint #7cf2a8. All text must be spelled exactly. Background dark forest charcoal #0a0c0b. A very restrained arrangement of a few abstract faceted geometric stone blocks in desaturated sage and warm cream, near far bottom edges only, tying the art to 3D modelling. Strong negative space, warm studio lighting, matte handcrafted aesthetic, no gradients behind text, no neon glow, no UI, no buttons, no Unity logo, no sale or discount, no invented game screenshots, no extra text. Essential text safely at least 8% from all edges. This is a brand illustration, not a product render.

Use attached kitchen screenshot as the exact work sample image, preserving it, NOT redesigning or replacing the real assets. Second image is the publisher avatar to use only as a 36px header avatar. Style from the existing personal site: near-black green #0a0c0b, off-white #e7ede8, muted sage #b4bfb7, mint #7cf2a8, geometric sans resembling Geologica, strong editorial typography, hairline rules, generous whitespace, no glows, no cards. Shared content width 1280 at 1440, 80px margins. Header 88px tall: small avatar and "maratg2" at left, "Work" and "Contact" at right. Hero starts about 190px from top, left text width 520px, right kitchen render in a 690x440 tasteful landscape frame. Exact H1 72px 500 weight three lines: "Low-poly props." / "Everyday" / "stories." First line white, last two mint. Below exact 18px paragraph "3D assets for Unity, with a soft spot for retro interiors and everyday details." Below one mint rounded CTA "Explore the first pack" with small diagonal arrow. Tiny caption under real image "Retro Kitchen / Unity scene render". No eyebrow above H1. This is a production design spec for a responsive Next.js page.
